purpose: Record independent HTTPS retrieval checks for every external artifact checksum in both Minecraft 26.3 Gradle verification manifests.

method.sidecarMatches: Fetched the official artifact .sha256 sidecar over HTTPS and compared it with the checksum in Gradle verification metadata.
method.directArtifactMatches: Where no matching sidecar was available, downloaded the exact artifact over HTTPS from the configured or official repository and computed SHA-256 locally.
method.scope: External artifact entries only. Fabric Loom's generated local Minecraft merge JAR/POM is excluded by the narrow trusted-artifact rule documented in the client verification manifest.
method.trustBoundary: Sidecars and artifact bytes are served by their respective official repository. This is a separate retrieval from Gradle's isolated caches, but it is not a third-party signature or cross-operator attestation.
